nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Computer Applications Technology
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology — Grade 10 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology Grade 10 Term 1 covering Systems Technologies (introduction to computers, computer management, hardware, software), Social Implications and Solution Development (Word Processing).

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Introduction to Computers
nodes.description: Explanation of what a computer is, overview of different types of computing devices, definitions and examples of main components of a computer system, ICTs used in everyday life, concepts of data and information.

assessmentStandards: Overview of the different types of computing devices
Overview and concepts of the main components of a computer system

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Computer Management
nodes.description: Start-up, desktop GUI, accessing apps, keyboard layout, enhancing keyboarding skills, drills, posture, ergonomics, file organisation (drives, folders, files, file specification, file manager, organise, copy, rename, delete, restore, move, search, view and sort files and folders).

assessmentStandards: Start-up: switch on the computer, log on (concept of access control)
Desktop (GUI): First looks, icons and shortcuts
Basic concepts and introduction to file organisation: Drives, folders, and files
File specification: Drive, path, filename and file extension
Files: File naming, conventions and properties - types and size
File manager, e.g. This PC, hierarchy
Organise, copy, rename, delete, restore, move, search, view and sort files and folders

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Hardware
nodes.description: Overview of basic hardware concepts: input, output, storage, definition of peripheral devices, methods for connecting peripheral devices (cabled and wireless).

assessmentStandards: Overview of basic concepts relating to hardware: Input, Output, Storage
Methods for connecting peripheral devices (cabled and wireless)

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Software
nodes.description: Overview of basic software concepts: system software vs application software, basic accessories, features for computing devices, application software overview, system software overview, basic security.

assessmentStandards: Overview of the basic concepts and introduction to software used on computing devices
What is software? (GUI), minimising, restoring, resizing, moving and closing windows
Basic accessories, features for computing devices
Application software (apps) - overview of basic concepts and introduction
System software - overview of basic concepts and introduction

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Social issues linked to term content: Ergonomics, green computing, health (posture), authentication, economic reasons for using computers.

assessmentStandards: Ergonomics, green computing, health (posture) and authentication

nodes.title: Solution Development: Word Processing
nodes.description: Introduction to word processing, workspace features, document structure, file management, text editing, basic punctuation, formatting marks, editing (cut, copy, paste, find and replace), font formatting, paragraph formatting, quick styles, reviewing, proofing, page layout, document layout, illustrations, text boxes.

assessmentStandards: What is word processing used for?
First looks: Workspace features such as ribbons, tabs and menus
Structure of the Word processing documents: pages, sections, paragraphs, lines, text and objects
File management in word processor: Open new and existing documents, close, save, save as and print
Select data using keyboard and/or mouse
Text: Entering, editing, and deleting text, special characters (symbols)
Basic punctuation: One space after all punctuation, including full stops
Editing: Cut, copy, paste, find and replace
Font type, style, size, colour, highlight and effects
Paragraph: Spacing (paragraph and line), alignment, borders, shading and indents (simple, increase and decrease)
Using existing quick styles in gallery (simple)
Autocorrect and basic Word processing typography: Quotes, dashes, and emphasis
Page layout: Page setup, margins, orientation, size, and page border
Document layout: Page numbers and page breaks
View options - print layout and preview
Insert and manipulate illustrations and text
Objects: Pictures, shapes, WordArt, basic SmartArt, screenshot, charts

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology Grade 10 Term 2 covering Systems Technologies (hardware, software, device management), Network Technologies, Social Implications, Solution Development (Word Processing, Spreadsheets) and Information Management.

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Hardware
nodes.description: Extended hardware concepts: input devices (pointing, scanning, video, audio, biometric), output devices, storage media and devices (memory cards, card readers), processing concepts.

assessmentStandards: Input: basic concepts, features and uses - Pointing devices, Scanning and reading devices, Video input, Audio input: Microphone, Biometric input
Output: basic concepts, features and uses - Audio output, Other output
Storage media and devices: Memory cards, Card reader
Processing: Overview and introduction to basic processing concepts

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Software and Device Management
nodes.description: Categories of software, licensing and licensing agreements, system software (drivers, auto configuration), utility programs, device management (creating shortcuts, adding peripherals, pairing devices, changing default printer, basic printing, compressing and decompressing files).

assessmentStandards: Basic printing and printer queue management on computing devices

nodes.title: Network Technologies: Networks
nodes.description: Overview of networks: what is a network, aims and objectives, facilitating communications, sharing hardware, software, data and information, basic security and privacy issues, examples of networks (Internet, LAN, HAN).

assessmentStandards: Facilitating communications and sharing hardware, software, data and information
Examples of networks: Internet, LAN, HAN

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Ethical use of content covered, software piracy, licensing, copyright and intellectual property.

assessmentStandards: Ethical use of content covered (hardware, software, computer management and networks)
Software piracy, licensing, copyright and intellectual property

nodes.title: Solution Development: Word Processing
nodes.description: Paragraphs (bullets, numbering, indents), tabs, view options, document and page layout (customising margins, headers and footers, cover page), tables (insert, design, layout, cells, text alignment, sorting, formulae).

assessmentStandards: View options: Work with more than one document, window, zoom; Document views: Draft and read mode
Document and page layout: Customising margins, Headers and footers, Insert cover page
Tables: Insert, table tools, table design, table properties
Design: Table styles, borders and shading
Layout: Rows and columns, header rows
Cells: Size, distribution, merging and splitting
Working with data: Sorting, convert to text and working with formulae (sum and average)

nodes.title: Solution Development: Spreadsheets
nodes.description: Overview of spreadsheets, workspace, cell references, cell ranges, basic calculations, data types, format cells, formatting rows/columns/sheets, file options, formulae vs functions, basic functions (SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN, MAX), error indicators.

assessmentStandards: Overview of the basic skills and core concepts of spreadsheets
Reinforce generic, common concepts as in word processor
File options: Open, save, save as, new and print
Basic functions (SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN, MAX)

nodes.title: Information Management
nodes.description: Data vs information, understanding the problem and task, problem-solving steps, role of questions and questioning, information sources and data gathering tools (electronic reference works, printed media, surveys, questionnaires, interviews).

assessmentStandards: Role of questions and questioning to determine information needs
Information sources and data gathering tools (including advantages and disadvantages)
Electronic reference works - Wikipedia and internet articles

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology Grade 10 Term 3 covering Network Technologies, Internet Technologies, Communication, Social Implications, Solution Development (Spreadsheets, Word Processing, Presentations, HTML/Web Design) and Information Management (PAT).

nodes.title: Network Technologies: Networks
nodes.description: Personal area network, Home Area Network (HAN), network device functions (modem, switch, router), communication channel and media, obtaining internet access, ISP definition and purpose.

assessmentStandards: Personal area network, Home Area Network (HAN)
Network device: Function of modem, switch and router

nodes.title: Internet Technologies: Internet and WWW
nodes.description: What is the internet, internet addresses, overview of WWW, browsers, search engines, concept of downloading and uploading, ISP.

assessmentStandards: Overview of the World Wide Web (WWW)

nodes.title: Internet Technologies: Communication
nodes.description: E-communication using computing devices, applications to facilitate e-communications, e-mail as a form of e-communication, scan to e-mail, netiquette rules, basic use of the internet and e-mail, hyperlinks, applying netiquette, basic e-mailing, attachments.

assessmentStandards: Overview of applications to facilitate e-communications
E-mail as a form of e-communication
Netiquette rules with regards to e-mail and social media platform
Basic use of the internet, e-mail and social platforms

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Digital citizenship (social issues, digital footprint, POPI Act), recognise and acknowledge ownership of electronic material, appropriate communication etiquette, safe e-mail and internet use.

assessmentStandards: Digital citizenship (what it is): Social issues, Digital footprint, POPI Act
Recognise and acknowledge the ownership of electronic material

nodes.title: Solution Development: Spreadsheets
nodes.description: Extended use of functions (TODAY, RANDBETWEEN, MODE, MEDIAN, COUNTA, COUNTBLANK, COUNTIF, relational operators), reduce decimal places, basic sorting, work with sheets (rename, tab colour, hide/unhide), headers and footers, basic printing.

assessmentStandards: Extend the use of basic functions: TODAY, RANDBETWEEN, MODE, MEDIAN, COUNTA, COUNTBLANK, COUNTIF
Reduce the number of decimal places using cell formatting
Work with sheets: Rename, tab colour, hide, unhide

nodes.title: Solution Development: Word Processing
nodes.description: Reviewing, styles (basic) linked to table of contents, referencing (basic), document layout (page setup, columns, hyphenation, watermark, page colour, integration - hyperlinks).

assessmentStandards: Styles (basic) linked to table of contents
Document layout: Page setup, Columns (line between), Hyphenation, Watermark, page colour

nodes.title: Solution Development: Presentations
nodes.description: Uses of presentations, first look, basic skills and core concepts, rules and best practice for creating a presentation, design ideas, slides (insert, delete, numbers, headers and footers), view options, integration techniques, custom animations, slide transitions, hyperlinks, adding videos and voice recordings, printing options, set up slide show, saving options.

assessmentStandards: Rules, best practice for creating a presentation
Slides: Insert, delete, numbers, headers and footers

nodes.title: Solution Development: HTML and Web Design
nodes.description: Websites, web pages, hyperlinks and URLs; what is HTML; what is an HTML editor; HTML syntax, order of tags; basic HTML tags (opening and closing tags); plain text and text formatting; attributes as a concept; font tag, face, colour and size attributes; width and size of (hr); body background colour; structure and design of a simple HTML page.

assessmentStandards: Reinforce the concepts: Websites, web pages, hyperlinks and URLs
Basic HTML tags: Opening tag and closing tag
Font tag, face, colour and size attribute
Structure and design of a simple HTML page

nodes.title: Information Management and PAT
nodes.description: Information vs knowledge, finding and accessing information and data, sifting information. PAT phases 1 and 2.

assessmentStandards: Find and access information and data

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology Grade 10 Term 4 covering Solution Development (Spreadsheets), Information Management and PAT Phase 2, Social Implications, Word Processing, Documents, Content using Case Studies and Final Examination.

nodes.title: Solution Development: Spreadsheets
nodes.description: Charts and graphs (pie, line, column and bar), purpose of each, when to use, create, format and edit; interpretation of information in a graph; basic integration techniques; solve problems using spreadsheets; troubleshoot basic spreadsheet problems.

assessmentStandards: Pie, line, column and bar charts
Purpose of each, when to use
Interpretation of information presented in a graph

nodes.title: Information Management and PAT
nodes.description: Knowledge vs insight, decision making, manipulating information, processing data, presentation of information (tables, graphs), report writing (introduction, body, conclusion, bibliography, references, copyright, plagiarism, intellectual property), summarising information. PAT Phase 2 completion.

assessmentStandards: Manipulating information (extract core meaning and summarise using own words)
Presentation of information in presentation software: Tables, graphs, techniques and tools in applications
Report writing - elements of a report: Introduction, body, conclusion, bibliography, references, copyright, plagiarism issues and intellectual property

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Impact on society, computer crime types (information theft, data theft and identity theft).

assessmentStandards: Computer crime - types: information theft, data theft and identity theft

nodes.title: Solution Development: Word Processing and Documents
nodes.description: Accessing online/offline help, integration techniques, troubleshoot basic Word processing problems, reproduce and create documents, use templates, support communication with appropriate features, integrate text and graphics, balance text and graphics, use media and visual literacy skills.

assessmentStandards: Accessing online, offline help including FAQs
Integration techniques (e.g., hyperlink files, copy and paste between applications)
Support communication with appropriate features such as images and symbols
Use media, visual literacy and technology skills to create products that express understanding

nodes.title: Content Using Case Studies
nodes.description: Identify basic hardware configuration, understand computers and their uses, understand how technology helps operate more efficiently and effectively, use computers as tools to access information and communicate, make better buying decisions, fix ordinary computer problems, use the internet and e-mail.

assessmentStandards: Identify the basic hardware configuration of a computer
Understand how technology helps one to operate more efficiently, effectively and more accurately
Know how to use computers as tools to access information and to communicate with others around the world
Know how to fix ordinary computer problems and deal with challenges that arise from utilising computers
Know how to use the internet and e-mail
